mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 3.5% in 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: Positive 5-day returns despite UNRATE exceeding 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indicate expanding economic activity, fostering optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the next month
failure_condition: Non-positive 60-day returns despite both proxies rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in FEDFUNDS above 3.5% triggers market concerns about inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 5-day returns despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor) and GDPC1 (demand) simultaneously signal strong employment growth and robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both PAYEMS and GDPC1 increase in the next month
failure_condition: Non-positive 20-day returns despite both proxies rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 4.0% for 60 days, persistent monetary tightening erodes market confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns despite FEDFUNDS above 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 100 signals contracting supply chains and weak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100 in the next month
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns despite INDPRO falling below 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained UNRATE below 2% reflects a tight labor market, boosting corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Non-positive 20-day returns despite UNRATE remaining below 2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year window.
